text.aria-label: Title text 'Primary D5, labelled (experiment 404): day-ahead forecasts (12 to 36 hours ahead), 2026-01 fit. Mean absolute error of the median during the event, points of capacity: lagless 16.0, S1 16.1, B-mix 15.5, K2-S1 15.2. Middle: the three lags the networks read. Bottom: each lag minus the lagless median at its half-hour (S1's surprise).'
text.tspan: Primary D5, labelled (experiment 404): day-ahead forecasts (12 to 36 hours ahead), 2026-01 fit.
Mean absolute error of the median during the event, points of capacity: lagless 16.0, S1 16.1, B-mix 15.5, K2-S1 15.2.
Middle: the three lags the networks read. Bottom: each lag minus the lagless median at its half-hour (S1's surprise).
